text:
sara_cs: KitsuneTech hit the APAC edge during a live demo. Theyre asking for a short-lived QPS bump + allowlist for their demo hosts (203.0.113.128/29) in hong kong (ap-east-1). Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, very sensitive to demo outcome. Can ops/infra help?
ben_ops: We can support. Ask: exact IPs to whitelist and preferred window?
taro_net: Provided sample egress IPs: 203.0.113.130 and 203.0.113.131. Demo window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 HKT. Customer requests soft QPS=2000, burst up to 3000, autorevoke after 24h and 12h pre-revoke notice. Also asked if we can pre-warm KV cache for their tenant during the window.
sara_cs: Customer message: "bursting ~450 rps per minute during load tests; need short bump + ensure cold-starts don't kill demo. pls pre-warm caches if possible."
ben_ops: Proposed config: soft=2000, hard=3000, autorevoke=24h, pre-warn 12h. Add CIDR 203.0.113.128/29 to tenant allowlist, add specific /32s for the two egress IPs. We'll add a one-off cache warm job for keys used in the demo. Need eng-infra signoff for region pin + cache warm permission.
taro_net: Minimal action list for eng-infra: 1) add CIDR 203.0.113.128/29 to tenant allowlist 2) add 203.0.113.130/32 and 203.0.113.131/32 to edge ACL 3) set tenant.kitsune soft=2000 hard=3000 4) schedule autorevoke @24h with 12h pre-notice 5) run cache-warm task 30m before window 6) smoke test from 203.0.113.130
infra-bot: infra-bot: draft change created 2026-01-17T00:00:00Z  status: pending-approval. Summary: ap-east-1 allowlist 203.0.113.128/29, add egress IPs, qps soft=2000 hard=3000, autorevoke=24h, cache-warm pre-run. Ticket: ENGOPS-8120
mika_renewals: Flagging renewals  demo result tied to renewal in 3 weeks. Please capture post-demo feedback + token-cost summary. If demo has issues, we'll escalate renewal outreach.
billing-bot: billing-bot: noted. Will estimate token-cost delta for the 2h window and send summary to sara_cs post-demo. Also confirm the $80 pre-approval cap requested by customer.
ben_ops: Validation curl to run after ACL applied:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.130" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expect: 200
ben_ops: Rollback criteria: sustained p50 latency > 500ms OR error rate > 2% for 2m -> revert limits + revoke cache warm, notify CS + customer. Also collect token counts and traces during window.
sara_cs: Customer asked for a one-paragraph confirmation email after changes and 12h pre-revoke notice. Can someone own the confirmation and the cache-warm job?
taro_net: I can own the cache-warm job and post the snippet here. I'll draft the confirmation email and paste for review.
ben_ops: ENGOPS-8120 assigned to @eng-infra and @edge-team. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-8120
sara_cs: Thanks team. Please post status updates here and ping me if approvals threaten the demo window. :thumbsup:
